The GAIA Lab is always open to students and researchers interested in
artificial intelligence applied to remote sensing, climate, forests, and
agriculture. Fill in the form below: it assembles an introduction email to the
lab coordinator — review it and send it from your own email.

```{=html}
<form id="join-form" class="join-form">
  <label for="join-nome">Name</label>
  <input id="join-nome" type="text" required>

  <label for="join-email">Your email</label>
  <input id="join-email" type="email" required>

  <label for="join-nivel">Intended level</label>
  <select id="join-nivel">
    <option>Undergraduate research</option>
    <option>Master's</option>
    <option>PhD</option>
    <option>Postdoc</option>
    <option>Other</option>
  </select>

  <label for="join-msg">Message</label>
  <textarea id="join-msg" rows="6" required
            placeholder="Briefly describe your background and research interests"></textarea>

  <button type="submit" class="join-submit">Prepare email</button>
</form>

<p class="join-alt">Or write directly to
<a class="email-protect" data-user="dario.oliveira" data-domain="fgv.br" role="button" tabindex="0">dario.oliveira [at] fgv.br</a>
(click to copy the address).</p>

<a class="back-link" href="/">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/></svg>
  <span>Back to home</span>
</a>

<script>
  // Monta um e-mail pré-preenchido com os dados do formulário e abre o
  // cliente de e-mail do visitante; o envio em si fica com o visitante.
  document.getElementById("join-form").addEventListener("submit", function (evento) {
    evento.preventDefault();
    var nome = document.getElementById("join-nome").value.trim();
    var email = document.getElementById("join-email").value.trim();
    var nivel = document.getElementById("join-nivel").value;
    var mensagem = document.getElementById("join-msg").value.trim();

    var assunto = "Interest in joining the GAIA Lab — " + nome;
    var corpo = "Name: " + nome + "\nEmail: " + email +
                "\nIntended level: " + nivel + "\n\n" + mensagem;

    // endereço montado em partes para não ficar exposto a robôs de spam
    var destino = ["dario", "oliveira"].join(".") + "@" + "fgv.br";
    window.location.href = "mailto:" + destino +
      "?subject=" + encodeURIComponent(assunto) +
      "&body=" + encodeURIComponent(corpo);
  });
</script>
```
